body: Looks like a very recent regression.
@lukas-reineke can you bisect? could be related to @lewis6991 recent extmark sign PRs.
Yeah, seems to have been introduced by #16897.

Yep, specifically this line which was moved outside the below `if`: https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/c3cc17f0e61d70436c601444298fceeafbfbacb3/src/nvim/screen.c#L2211

Moving it back inside the `if` fixes the issue, but will of course break signs.

issue.title: fix(extmarks): fix signs

repository.name: neovim
repository.description: Vim-fork focused on extensibility and usability

issue.body:
Don't add sign extmarks to state->active. Instead when drawing signs,
    perform a full line scan for sign marks. This allows decor_redraw_line
    to be moved back inside the `!number_only` block in screen.c, which
    prevents decor scans when redrawing the number column when
    'relativenumber' is set.

Fixes: #17638
